table.name: TLGNR_SAP_MATERIAL_NORM_BS
table.description: Norm types as distinguished by SAP (e.g. NF=French Norm, U=U Norm). Used in the material-norm import interface as reference data. For each material produced at a certain plant certain norm definitions are sent to LOGON from SAP. On the Logon delivery notes these norms define the logos rendered for the ordered item(s). Each such norm can be associated with a logo. The logo itself can be language specific and is stored in tlgnc_image table.

column.name: SAP_MATERIAL_NORM_CD
column.description: PK. Code of the Reference Data as known in SAP. E.g. U, AENOR, AGG_PP, AGG_CE, CE, NF, ... (Codes identical to SAP, domain ZNORM1)

column.name: NORM_SHORT_DESC
column.description: Short description of the norm. I.e., AENOR = Spanish Norm, AGG_PP = Production Site, AGG_CE = European Norm, CE = CE Norm, U = U Norm, NF = French Norm.

column.name: DN_LOGO_IMAGE_NAME
column.description: Name of the image to be used when printing delivery notes. Lookup in tlgnc_image is first by dn_logo_image_name+'_lang', and if not found, just dn_logo_image_name is used. ('lang' = language in which the delivery note is to be printed, typically the language of the shipto).

column.name: SEQUENCE_NO
column.description: Unique number; defines the sequence in which the logos/norm data is to be rendered on the delivery note when several logos are to be printed. E.g. 10, 20, 21, 31, 32, 33, 40, ...

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
